test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Three identical light bulbs are connected to a battery as shown below. P, Q, X, Y and Z represent several points in the circuit. Which of the following holds true for this circuit?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53b0395257c72af94db7cc4778ca4ab6502a38b485d877dc508586746624d46c.png]

options.text: The current at Q is greater than the current at P.
The current at P is greater than the current at Q.
Only the currents at P and Q are the same.
The current is the same at all locations.

solution: The correct answer is __**The current at P is greater than the current at Q**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
